description: Map superseded CFR (title, part) pairs to their current replacements. Keys are strings of the form 'TITLE:PART' (e.g. '45:74'). Values name the replacement part and include provenance so future agents understand why the remap exists.

45:74.reason: OMB Uniform Guidance codified at 2 CFR Part 200; HHS implementing rule at 45 CFR Part 75 superseded the pre-2014 45 CFR Part 74 administrative requirements for HHS grants.
